chunks: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said:
I said to Al-Reza (peace be upon him): 'A man prays on a bed made of sandalwood and prostrates on the sandalwood.' He said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray on a wooden bed or furniture?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) validates the permissibility of praying on a *sarir* (a raised wooden bed or platform) made of sandalwood, affirming that prostration directly upon its surface is valid. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding prayer surfaces, distinguishing between the material's purity and the structural elevation, thereby accommodating various domestic settings while maintaining the sanctity of the prayer posture.
